one_line: Pallava king who rose from a collateral line during the succession crisis and ruled from Kanchipuram.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean but athletic build with a regal, disciplined posture
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown South Indian complexion, sharp nose, defined jaw, large expressive anime-style eyes, a small tilaka mark on the forehead, and a calm, thoughtful default expression that hints at strategic resolve.
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted at the center, gathered into a high, neatly tied topknot at the back of the crown, with a smooth, narrow gold circlet resting across the forehead and a small central gem; short, tidy side hair framing the ears.
appearance.costume: royal Pallava-style attire: a fitted long-sleeved upper garment in soft cream-colored cotton reaching just below the hips, bordered at cuffs and hem with narrow maroon and gold bands; over this, a deep maroon silk uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, its edges embroidered with repeating small geometric gold motifs; lower body covered by a full, ankle-length white veshti/dhoti, pleated at the front, with a broad maroon border and a thin gold stripe; simple leather sandals; jewellery includes a short gold necklace with small round beads, a longer necklace with a single oval pendant resting mid-chest, gold armlets on both upper arms with leaf motifs, slim gold bangles on wrists, and small round gold stud earrings, all refined rather than ostentatious.
appearance.signature: a long, slightly curved South Indian steel sword with a plain bronze hilt and disc-shaped pommel, carried sheathed in a brown leather scabbard with maroon and gold binding, worn at his left hip, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Nandivarman II Pallavamalla is a mid-20s, lean South Indian king with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot hair under a gold circlet, wearing cream long-sleeved royal tunic, maroon shawl, white dhoti with maroon-gold border, gold jewellery, and a sheathed curved sword at his left hip in cream, white, maroon, gold, and brown hues.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style model sheet of Nandivarman II Pallavamalla: a mid-20s, lean South Indian king with an oval medium-brown face, sharp nose, defined jaw, large thoughtful eyes and a small tilaka, his thick black hair tied in a high topknot with a smooth gold circlet and small central gem across his forehead. Show him in Pallava royal attire: a cream-colored, long-sleeved fitted upper garment with narrow maroon and gold borders at cuffs and hem, covered by a deep maroon silk shawl draped from his left shoulder across the chest and back, its edges decorated with fine gold geometric motifs. His ankle-length white dhoti is neatly pleated with a broad maroon border and thin gold stripe, and he wears simple brown leather sandals. Add refined jewellery: short gold bead necklace, longer necklace with single oval pendant, gold armlets with leaf patterns on both upper arms, slim gold bangles, and small round gold stud earrings. At his left hip is a long, slightly curved South Indian steel sword in a brown leather scabbard bound with maroon and gold, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by cream, white, maroon, gold, and brown, and pose him front-facing with clear, clean details so the design can be redrawn consistently.
